assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and persistent dizziness
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is indicated
CPT 93226 represents a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The denial was under Reason Code PR-204
The service is medically necessary to identify arrhythmias responsible for the patient's syncope, dizziness, and transient cerebral ischemic attacks
